description: Behavior evals check that when fired the skill: refuses if any impl report is missing, stubs only out-of-scope services in WireMock (never in-scope services), derives scenarios from the ticket not code paths, always tears down docker-compose after the run, surfaces non-obvious stubs to the user rather than silently guessing, and on test failure stays at phase: integration_test rather than advancing to review — needs_repair with feedback_ref for code-fixable failures, failed/blocker when a contract change is needed.

cases.prompt: Integration test PROJ-1234. feature-state.json shows phase: integration_test. Two services are in scope: order-service and payment-service. order-service has an impl report at features/PROJ-1234/order-service-impl-report.md but payment-service has no impl report yet. Describe what you do.

Integration test PROJ-1234. In-scope services: order-service and payment-service. Out-of-scope dependencies: customer-service (called by order-service) and inventory-service (called by order-service). Describe which services get WireMock stubs and which are built from worktrees in docker-compose.

Integration test PROJ-1234. Ticket: 'Add 5% loyalty discount on orders over $100 for Gold-tier customers, with a confirmation notification sent after discount is applied.' In-scope: order-service, payment-service, notification-service. Describe how you derive the integration test scenarios.
Integration test PROJ-1234. The test suite runs and 2 of 4 tests fail. Describe whether you run docker-compose down after the failures.

Integration test PROJ-1234. order-service calls customer-service at /api/customers/{id}/preferences. The OpenAPI spec for customer-service does not clearly define what this endpoint returns. Describe what you generate for this stub and whether you tell the user.

The integration test runner has finished for PROJ-1234. Results: 3 of 4 scenarios passed, 1 failed (paymentFailure_skipsNotification): order-service publishes order.created before payment is confirmed. The contract already says order.created is published only after payment confirmation, so the fix is in order-service. You are at Step 8 of the workflow. What JSON do you write to feature-state.json? Show only the JSON block.

The integration test runner has finished for PROJ-1234. 1 of 3 scenarios failed: notification-service needs the customer's email in the order.created event, but the approved contract's payload has no email field, so neither side can fix it without changing the contract. You are at Step 8 of the workflow. What JSON do you write to feature-state.json? Show only the JSON block.
